header.title: For My Beloved, Adored, and Plushy-like Munchkin,
header.subtitle: This is for your low days, days you don't feel like talking, and for the inevitable day I make you mad agian.

introLetter:
To my sugar plum, my cookie dough, my muffin with vanilla ice cream,

I started working around about when I had my first dream about us, our future, what we're like in the future, where we are, the entire works. It happened on 17th July, and I haven't been able to stop thinking about it since then.

One day that dream will be our reality. Till then, let this mixtape keep you company. 

Yours Truely,"Chumkins"

This is a test letter for the first song.

It should type out character by character as the song plays.

When about 20 seconds remain, the text will start removing itself character by character.

Pretty cool, right?
